messages:
maria: heads-up — we saw a spike in pod evictions in us-west2 about 5m ago, mostly tiny-gpu pods that are part of multi-pod gangs. log excerpt:
maria: ``ERROR scheduling: preempted 3/5 gang members, left 2 pending (reason: fractional-preempt-threshold)``

sanjay: hmm, fractional-preempt-threshold was rolled out in the scheduler patch yesterday. did it default to 0.5 or 0.7 for us-west2?

devon: default was 0.6 in the rollout canary. we expected it to avoid killing whole gangs but it seems to be leaving partial gangs unschedulable.

maria: exactly. apps hit QOS=burstable, they lose some members and then the rest sit pending for >10m. leads to tokenized KV cache thrash and cost spikes.

rahul: tagging autoscaler: @sanjay did we also change binpack scoring? if scoring pulled tiny pods to same nodes, fractional preempt could leave holes.

sanjay: we did tweak affinity weights for cpu/gpu balancing. combined effect might be: denser tiny-pod placement + fractional preempt = fragmentation spiral.

devon: quick mitigation idea: flip fractional-preempt to conservative (0.9) for affected AZs and re-evaluate. canary it on us-west2-a first.

maria: can we hotpatch via kustomize? scheduler args live in config map `kube-scheduler-ops`.

sanjay: yes — can do a rolling restart of scheduler pods after updating config map. snippet I plan to apply:

sanjay: ```yaml
# patch
- op: replace
  path: /spec/containers/0/args/3
  value: "--fractional-gang-preempt-threshold=0.9"
```

rahul: also recommend a quick taint to keep new tiny jobs off newly consolidated nodes: `kubectl taint nodes gw-uw2-*-pool preempttest=true:NoSchedule` until we confirm.

maria: good call. any thoughts on longer-term?

devon: we should add a scheduler metric: `scheduler_fractional_preempt_partial_gang_count` and alert on >5/m for 10m. that will catch regressions.

sanjay: agree. also consider a post-filter that ensures gang atomicity by default for jobs labeled `redwood.gang=true` unless opt-in to fractional.

rahul: ops-runbook-bot: pull relevant runbook.

ops-runbook-bot: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gang-preemption — steps for rollback, patch, and mitigation. includes rollback playbook and pod-impact checklist.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0398 -> "partial-gang-preempt-us-west2" assigned to eng-platform oncall.

maria: I'm going to increase alert thresholds for cache thrash and create a postmortem stub.

devon: i'll work on metric and small scheduler unit test to validate fractional behavior for different gang sizes.

sanjay: i'll patch the config to 0.9 in us-west2-a canary and post status here in 10m. if good, promote across cluster.

maria: thanks team. please add brief notes to the incident with the exact config diff. :thumbsup:

sanjay: will do. :eyes:

rahul: if anyone sees eviction rate drop and pending gang count down, mark INC resolved and document cost delta.

maria: noted — keeping this thread for the timeline.
